subject: Mutual action plan: Compass Health onboarding & handoff playbook
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morris <alice.morris@compasshealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + proposed 90-day implementation cadence

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that lines up milestones, owners, and dates for the 90-day onboarding sprint. High-level ask: can you review the milestones in the first tab and confirm Compass Health owners for the two decision gates (Security sign-off and Data mapping completion)? I’ve also noted the kickoff window we discussed (week of Dec 13) and a proposed go-live target of Mar 12.

Key milestones (short):
- Week 0 (Dec 13): Kickoff + environment provisioning
- Week 2: Security questionnaire responses + initial SOC/infra checklist
- Week 4: Data ingestion POC (sample dataset)
- Week 8: Acceptance tests and integration smoke tests
- Week 12 (Mar 12): Go-live (soft launch)

Attachments: CompassHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (master MAP) and CompassHealth_Requirements_20261201.xlsx (requirements we captured).

A few clarifying notes:
- Responsibility lines are split (Redwood operations = infra + runtime config; Compass = data owners + validation).
- We recommend a weekly 30m sync for the first 8 weeks and then biweekly through go-live.

If that timeline looks roughly right, I’ll convert the map into a shared Drive doc and open the HubSpot mutual action plan so we can assign owners and due dates.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
O: 415-555-0142 | aisha@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed 90-day implementation cadence

Thanks Aisha — this is helpful. A few quick items from our side after an initial read-through:

- Security sign-off: our InfoSec lead (cc’d: Kevin) needs at least two weeks to complete the vendor risk assessment once we get the SOC and architecture diagram. Can we move the sign-off milestone to Week 3 and include a dedicated walkthrough for their questions?
- Data mapping: we’ll be able to provide the sample dataset by Dec 22, but the full mapping will take until Jan 25 given downstream approvals.
- Kickoff: Dec 14 (Tuesday) works better for the team — prefer morning PT.

I uploaded a short spreadsheet with the data field owners and our preferred kickoff agenda (see CompassHealth_Requirements_20261201.xlsx). We’ll need an item in the MAP that calls out the escalation path (who to contact if the PII scope changes).

We’re generally aligned on the Mar 12 soft launch but would like a one-week wiggle room if the data mapping slips.

Best,
Alice Morris
Head of Digital Operations | Compass Health
alice.morris@compasshealth.com

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed 90-day implementation cadence

Alice — thanks for the notes and the timing clarity. I updated the MAP to reflect three changes you requested: move Security sign-off to Week 3, set data sample delivery to Dec 22, and kickoff scheduled for Tue Dec 14 10:00 PT. I also added an escalation row and a placeholder for PII scope changes (owner: Compass InfoSec).

I’ve synced on internal owners: Marissa will lead post-kickoff implementation orchestration and Priya will be the primary CSM during onboarding; Ben is on pricing/contract follow-ups if we need chargeable professional services later.

Next actions:
- Alice / Kevin: confirm Compass owners for Security walkthrough and Data mapping owner by Mon Dec 7
- Redwood (Aisha / Marissa / Priya): prepare kickoff agenda and runbook draft by Fri Dec 11

I’ve converted the MAP into a shared Drive doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_compass-map and pushed the HubSpot MAP draft (link below). I’ll also include the brief SOC paper and architecture diagram in the Drive before the walkthrough.

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot due dates once we get owner confirmations.

Warmly,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: owner assignments and runbook outline (Compass Health)

Internal note — please treat as internal coordination (do not forward to Compass without cleanup):

Marissa / Aisha,

I drafted the implementation runbook outline and assigned owner roles for the first 8 weeks. Highlights:
- Provisioning & access (Owner: Marissa Cole) — AM/PM checklist for VPC endpoints, KMS keys, and account mappings
- Security walkthrough & remedials (Owner: Kevin Torres / Compass; Redwood support: Priya) — include a 60m call and follow-up ticketing for any infra gaps
- Data ingestion POC (Owner: Compass data owner; Redwood support: Priya & Eng ops) — require sample schema + delivery checklist
- Acceptance criteria & test plan (Owner: Priya Natarajan) — include top 10 business flows and 3 performance baselines (latency/cost/accuracy)

I also added contingency lanes for data-mapping slip: if full mapping not complete by Jan 25, we’ll scope a phased go-live (read-only for first 2 endpoints) and push final cutover 3 weeks after mapping complete.

Attachments: runbook outline (in Drive folder). I will build the formal runbook doc by Fri Dec 11 and share a clean version to Compass for the kickoff packet.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
